images.caption: Agriculture Secretary Sonny Perdue visiting the Dona Sofia Polo Ranch in San Antonio de Areco, Argentina on July 29, 2018. Secretary Perdue meets with the owner, as well as veterinarian and breeding staff to discuss new breeding and genetics technologies for horses and cattle. Secretary Perdue is in Argentina for the G-20 Conference. USDA photo.
